cheat.title: Classify matter in order
items: Is there an & or the words dissolved, solution, air, alloy or mixture? It is a mixture. Mixtures can be separated by physical means and can vary in amount.
No &: count capital letters. One capital letter (O₂, P₄, O₃, Co) is an element, even with a subscript.
Two or more different capital letters (H₂O, CO, NaCl) is a compound. CO is a compound; Co is the element cobalt.
Element and compound together are pure substances. A mixture is not a pure substance.

cheat.title: States of matter
rows: Close together, slide past each other

cheat.title: Temperature and state changes
items: 0 K = -273.15 °C is absolute zero: the minimum possible particle motion, so nothing is colder.
At 0 °C ice and liquid water coexist and a little vapor is in the air: all three states.
Speed up (melting, boiling, evaporation, sublimation) = more energy, less order. Slow down (freezing, condensation, deposition) = less energy, more order.

cheat.title: Colloid types
rows: Solid in gas / liquid in gas
Solid in solid / gas in solid

cheat.title: Reaction types
items: Combustion: burns in oxygen to make carbon dioxide and water. Synthesis: two or more substances combine into something new.
Decomposition: one substance breaks down into two or more. Single displacement: an element is pushed out of a compound.
Double displacement: the positive parts of two compounds switch places.

cheat.title: Changes of state (all physical)
items: Melting: solid to liquid. Freezing: liquid to solid.
Boiling or evaporating: liquid to gas. Condensing: gas to liquid.
Sublimation: solid straight to gas (dry ice). The substance is the same before and after.

cheat.title: Physical or chemical?
rows: Same substance after: melting, boiling, dissolving, crushing, cutting
New substance after: burning, rusting, baking, souring, electrolysis
Measured without changing it: color, density, melting and boiling point
Ability to form new substances: flammability, rusting, decomposing
Is the substance still the same afterward?

cheat.title: Evidence of a chemical change
items: Precipitate: a solid forms when two liquids or pure substances react
Gas given off: bubbles from a reaction (not from boiling, and not dissolved gas coming out of soda)
Color change that makes a new substance (not just more dye)
Temperature change (heat given off or absorbed)
Light given off
Odor is a physical property, so a smell by itself is not a sign

cheat.title: Separating mixtures (all physical)
rows: Dissolved solid from a liquid (keeps the solid)
Liquid from a dissolved solid, or liquids from each other (keeps the liquid)
Dyes or other components in a sample
A mobile phase moves each part a different distance across a fixed phase
Need a chemical change such as electrolysis

cheat.title: Traps
items: Atom is not the same as element, and molecule is not the same as compound. O₂ is a molecule and an element.
Boiling bubbles are water vapor: physical. Dissolving is physical.
Burning, rusting, cooking and souring are chemical.
In a mixture each substance keeps its own properties. A compound has properties unlike its elements.
Intensive properties (density, color, melting point) do not depend on amount; extensive ones (mass, volume) do.
Electrolysis of water splits a compound into hydrogen and oxygen. Boiling water does not.
